findings.title: Reject deployment metadata outside its declared Mach-O command or architecture slice
findings.initialEvidence: The real CLI returned staticDeploymentCheckPassed=true for a short LC_BUILD_VERSION command and a fat arm64 slice shorter than its load-command region. Required browser binaries were present in the fixture, so these were true top-level false greens. otool reported malformed commands. Expanded initial matrix reproduced six false greens.
findings.resolution: inspect now validates explicit slice boundaries, fat header/table and slices, thin CPU identity, sizeofcmds, command sizes, BUILD_VERSION and VERSION_MIN_MACOS minimum sizes, tool table bounds, and total command-region consumption. Independent 14-case CLI matrix and 9 additional parser boundary controls all match expectations.

validation.method: Independent system otool cross-check of three real binaries
validation.result: NumPy minimum14.0, Chromium13.0, optional ffmpeg15.0 agree with audit. This independently corroborates selected deployment metadata, not runtime compatibility.

validation.method: Review real Chromium-only E2E execution evidence and production browser paths
validation.result: Production new_page() has no video-recording options or video API. Requiring complete Chromium while omitting optional ffmpeg and headless shell preserves current P3 browser tools; actual 26-assertion run exercises Chromium launch, DOM operations, isolated profiles and cleanup without those caches.

limitations: Static arm64 Mach-O declaration audit only; does not establish imported-symbol compatibility, complete binary closure, signing or clean-machine offline release.
No actual macOS14 execution performed. Current host execution is not counted as the macOS14 gate.
Required browser paths are pinned to the prepared Chromium1248/156.0.8078.4 candidate and must be updated deliberately if the prepared runtime changes.
Windows same-candidate CI is outside this review; no Windows pass is claimed.
Optional video recording is not provided by current browser tools; adding it requires dependency/OS validation including ffmpeg rather than reusing this result.
